text.printed:
During step 2 of the villain phase, The Russian activates against you before The Punisher does.
Forced Interrupt: When The Russian would be defeated by a friendly character or a player card, discard the top card of the encounter deck. If that card is a minion, reset The Russian's hit points to 1 instead.
